sections.text:
The scheme protection system for steam 
turbine is manufactured by CEE France and this Scheme is a solid state type. The 
scheme protection will protect generator, step up transformer, There is table 
for protective relays.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez, 
tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo., and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of
 Damietta 
Power Station.

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Steam turbine out of service and work 
 permit required.

text:
Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
The scheme protection system for steam 
turbine is manufactured by CEE France and this Scheme is a solid state type. The 
scheme protection will protect generator, step up transformer, There is table 
for protective relays.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez, 
tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo., and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of
 Damietta 
Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Steam turbine out of service and work 
 permit required.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Make sure CT 
 secondary circuit are shorted.
Voltage 
transformer miniature circuit breakers (m.c.b) is opened
Tools and Equipment
Siemens test 
 set which consists of two units
Current unit 
 type 7VP48.
Voltage unit 
 type 7VP49.
Voltmeter,
 Ammeter.
Test leads, 
 screw driver.
